lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਭਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagar mer udiaan ban nav kha(n)d basudhaa bharam ||
lines.translation: I would cross the oceans, mountains, wilderness, forests and the nine regions of the earth in a single step,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੈ ਗਨਉ ਏਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: moosan prem pira(n)m kai ganau ek kar karam ||3||
lines.translation: O Musan, for the Love of my Beloved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਸਕਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ਜੁ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਛਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: moosan masakar prem kee rahee j a(n)bar chhaai ||
lines.translation: O Musan, the Light of the Lord's Love has spread across the sky;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਧੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਭਵਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: beedhe baa(n)dhe kamal mahi bhavar rahe lapataai ||4||
lines.translation: I cling to my Lord, like the bumble bee caught in the lotus flower. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨ ਮਹਤ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਬ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam harakh sukh maan mahat ar garab ||
lines.translation: Chanting and intense meditation, austere self-discipline, pleasure and peace, honor, greatness and pride

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਨਿਮਖਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਰਬ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: moosan nimakhak prem par vaar vaar de(n)u sarab ||5||
lines.translation: - O Musan, I would dedicate and sacrifice all these for a moment of my Lord's Love. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਮਰਤ ਹਿਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: moosan maram na jaanaee marat hirat sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: O Musan, the world does not understand the Mystery of the Lord; it is dying and being plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਨ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਮਿਥ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: prem pira(n)m na bedhio urajhio mith biuhaar ||6||
lines.translation: It is not pierced through by the Love of the Beloved Lord; it is entangled in false pursuits. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਬੁ ਦਬੁ ਜਬ ਜਾਰੀਐ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghab dab jab jaareeai bichhurat prem bihaal ||
lines.translation: When someone's home and property are burnt, because of his attachment to them, he suffers in the sorrow of separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮੂਸੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: moosan tab hee mooseeai bisarat purakh daiaal ||7||
lines.translation: O Musan, when mortals forget the Merciful Lord God, then they are truly plundered. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤਵ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ko prem suaau hai charan chitav man maahi ||
lines.translation: Whoever enjoys the taste of the Lord's Love, remembers His Lotus Feet in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak birahee braham ke aan na katahoo jaahi ||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the lovers of God do not go anywhere else. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਘਾਟੀਂ ਊਂਚੌ ਘਨੋ ਚੰਚਲ ਚੀਤ ਬਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh ghaatee(n) oo(n)chau ghano cha(n)chal cheet bihaal ||
lines.translation: Climbing thousands of steep hillsides, the fickle mind becomes miserable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਘਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਲ ਜਮਾਲ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: neech keech nimrit ghanee karanee kamal jamaal ||9||
lines.translation: Look at the humble, lowly mud, O Jamaal: the beautiful lotus grows in it. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਨੈਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਸਿਆਮ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਦਨ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamal nain a(n)jan siaam cha(n)dr badan chit chaar ||
lines.translation: My Lord has lotus-eyes; His Face is so beautifully adorned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਗਨ ਮਰੰਮ ਸਿਉ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: moosan magan mara(n)m siu kha(n)d kha(n)d kar haar ||10||
lines.translation: O Musan, I am intoxicated with His Mystery. I break the necklace of pride into bits. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੂਧ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: magan bhaio pri prem siu soodh na simarat a(n)g ||
lines.translation: I am intoxicated with the Love of my Husband Lord; remembering Him in meditation, I am not conscious of my own body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਭਇਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਧਮ ਪਤੰਗ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: pragat bhaio sabh lo mahi naanak adham pata(n)g ||11||
lines.translation: He is revealed in all His Glory, all throughout the world. Nanak is a lowly moth at His Flame. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok bhagat kabeer jeeu ke ||
lines.translation: Saloks Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿਮਰਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer meree simaranee rasanaa oopar raam ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, my rosary is my tongue, upon which the Lord's Name is strung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaadee sagal bhagat taa ko sukh bisraam ||1||
lines.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, all the devotees abide in tranquil peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹਸਨੇਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer meree jaat kau sabh ko hasanehaar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, everyone laughs at my social class.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਇਸ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਉ ਜਿਹ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree is jaat kau jih japio sirajanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to this social class, in which I chant and meditate on the Creator. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਡਗਮਗ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਡੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer dagamag kiaa karahi kahaa dulaavahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, why do you stumble? Why does your soul waver?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕੋ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh ko naaiko raam naam ras peeu ||3||
lines.translation: He is the Lord of all comforts and peace; drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਬਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ka(n)chan ke ku(n)dal bane oopar laal jaRaau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, earrings made of gold and studded with jewels,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਦਾਧੇ ਕਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: deesahi daadhe kaan jiu jinh man naahee naau ||4||
lines.translation: look like burnt twigs, if the Name is not in the mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ek aadh jo jeevat miratak hoi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, rare is such a person, who remains dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhai hoi kai gun ravai jat pekhau tat soi ||5||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he is fearless. Wherever I look, the Lord is there. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਉ ਮੂਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa din hau mooaa paachhai bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, on the day when I die, afterwards there shall be bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਜਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: mohi milio prabh aapanaa sa(n)gee bhajahi goubi(n)d ||6||
lines.translation: I shall meet with my Lord God. Those with me shall meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਬੁਰੇ ਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer sabh te ham bure ham taj bhalo sabh koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I am the worst of all. Everyone else is good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jin aisaa kar boojhiaa meet hamaaraa soi ||7||
lines.translation: Whoever understands this is a friend of mine. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਈ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aaee mujhahi pahi anik kare kar bhes ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, she came to me in various forms and disguises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਉਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: ham raakhe gur aapane un keeno aades ||8||
lines.translation: My Guru saved me, and now she bows humbly to me. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਮੂਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer soee maareeai jih mooai sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, kill only that, which, when killed, shall bring peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bhalo bhalo sabh ko kahai buro na maanai koi ||9||
lines.translation: Everyone shall call you good, very good, and no one shall think you are bad. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਾਰੇ ਊਭੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer raatee hovahi kaareeaa kaare oobhe ja(n)t ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the night is dark, and men go about doing their dark deeds.
